Auth-by-Bearer, categories seeding, transactions CRUD+filters, analytics, CSV export, Gemini 3 Flash text parsing (3/3 correct), Telegram status/link-code all pass. Frontend landing renders, dashboard w/ session cookie shows summary cards, AI quick-add creates transaction with toast, Transactions page filters + export present, Telegram page shows amber warning + generated 6-char code + copy button.

GET /api/categories returns 12 Indonesian defaults (Makanan & Minuman ... Pendapatan Lain)
POST/GET/PUT/DELETE /api/transactions all work; date range/type/q filters all return correct count
GET /api/transactions/export returns text/csv with Indonesian headers (Tanggal, Jenis, Kategori, Deskripsi, Jumlah (Rp), Sumber)
Landing page loads with hero, Telegram mockup, CTA
Dashboard with session cookie: summary-balance/income/expense, ai-text-input, ai-submit-btn all present

Telegram page shows amber warning (bot belum dikonfigurasi), generate-code-btn creates link-code-display (e.g. 2NIJ5E), copy-code-btn present
